evidence.criterion: XState v5 expresses session/wave top-level states and AI output cannot bypass guards directly
evidence.proof: commitEvent in lib/db/commit.ts restores an XState actor from the persisted snapshot, sends the canonical event, and only persists domain records and state head when the actor transitions. app/api/session, app/api/session/consent, app/api/wave, app/api/feedback and app/api/final all route through commitEvent. Guard rejection is detected when neither state value nor context revision changes.

commitEvent implements idempotency-key replay, idempotency-payload conflict detection, stale-base-revision rejection and monotonic revision increment. The full flow reaches parallel_lives_ready. Unit tests cover idempotency, revision conflict, invalid state and PERSISTENCE_ERROR rollback.

evidence.criterion: Canonical v3 domain records are persisted for waves, answers, insights, calibrations and route intents
evidence.proof: persistWaveMission, persistAnswer, persistInsight, persistCalibration and persistRouteIntents in lib/db/commit.ts upsert domain records transactionally. Wave 1 template now commits a canonical Wave mission with elicitation units, microbatch and questions.

evidence.criterion: Existing integration and e2e regressions remain passing
evidence.proof: Full Playwright integration suite (30 tests) passes; e2e mobile and desktop suites (18 tests) pass; pnpm typecheck, build and lint (0 errors) pass; contract and unit tests pass.

evidence.criterion: Main conversation APIs route through the XState ledger for the full conversation flow
evidence.proof: GET/POST /api/wave emits WAVE_MISSION_COMMITTED, ANSWER_SUBMITTED, WAVE_END_COMMITTED and INSIGHT_COMMITTED. POST /api/feedback emits CALIBRATION_SUBMITTED, NEXT_WAVE_COMMITTED or ROUTE_PHASE_ENTERED. POST /api/final emits ROUTE_PHASE_ENTERED, ROUTE_INTENT_CANDIDATES_COMMITTED, ORDINARY_DAY_SCREENING_STARTED, ORDINARY_DAYS_COMMITTED and PARALLEL_LIVES_COMMITTED.

evidence.criterion: Full two-wave + final plan ledger is revision-safe and monotonic
evidence.proof: tests/integration/harness-state.test.ts asserts the exact event sequence, monotonic revisions, unique idempotency keys and final parallel_lives_ready state.
